stances_toward.note: The Arakan Army holds 14 Rakhine townships and Paletwa and fights for Sittwe and Kyaukphyu, the two places Naypyidaw needs. Not adversary in the atlas's mortal sense: the army and the AA agreed a humanitarian truce brokered by the Nippon Foundation in Nov 2022, and no source read here says either side seeks the other's destruction. The junta's own language for the AA (terrorist designation) was not sourced in this pass, so the grade is the atlas's structural reading (C). The resistance as a whole (NUG, PDFs, KIA, KNU) is not graded: no source read in this pass states the junta's reading (gap). Bond grievance.
